content.text:
That matches Tailwind's documented behavior — Tailwind scans source files as plain text and only generates CSS for class names it can find complete and unbroken in the source. Since `{{ Vite::image('hero.jpg') }}` is a Blade expression resolved at PHP render time, the actual `bg-[url('...')]` class isn't a static, complete string in your source, so Tailwind's build-time scanner never detects/generates it.

Source: `src/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files.mdx` — "Detecting Classes in Source Files" (lines 78–131), e.g. "Always use complete class names... Tailwind will generate all of your CSS perfectly every time."

Your inline `style="background-image: url(...)"` fix works because it bypasses Tailwind's class generation entirely.
